paraphrase: Sants, see — the world has gone mad: tell the truth and they run to beat you, tell lies and they trust you. The Hindu says Rām is dear to him, the Turk says Rahīm; they fight each other to death and neither knows the secret. Many pīrs and holy men read their books, many practise rites and austerities, many wear sectarian marks and garlands — all are lost in pride and have not found the one within.
